### 2.2 Import and Merge ACRA files





::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Get a list of all CSV files in your folder
file_list <- list.files(path = "data/ACRAInformationonCorporateEntities",
                        pattern = "\\.csv$", 
                        full.names = TRUE)

# Read all files into a list of data frames
list_of_dfs <- lapply(file_list, read.csv) # Use read.csv2 if your data uses ';' as separator

# Combine the list into one single data frame
combined_df <- do.call("rbind", list_of_dfs)
glimpse(combined_df)
```
